data.name: Mirsalah
data.gender_notes: Mirsalah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mirsalah means 'Commander of the Mercy'. This name is rooted in the Islamic belief that Allah (God) is the ultimate source of mercy and compassion. The name conveys a deep sense of responsibility and leadership, as well as a strong connection to the divine. The name Mirsalah carries the meaning “Commander of the Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirsalah usually hope their child will grow to embody commander of the mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in Islamic symbolism, Mirsalah is a reminder of the boundless mercy and compassion of Allah.
data.etymology: Mirsalah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Commander of the Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirsalah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
